title: Harden pending publish drain guard freshness
summary: Bind Pending Publish recovery dry-run rows to the current pending-publish payload signature, clear stale recovery evidence when the payload changes, and ignore mismatched recovery rows in drain guard evidence.
reason: A stale blocked recovery dry-run could keep the WebView drain guard in a do-not-drain state after the backend returned a fresh ready-looking Pending Publish payload.
behavior_before: Recovery dry-run rows were stored as unscoped WebView state and could continue influencing drain confidence, drain checklist, and drain-scope preview after Pending Publish evidence changed.
behavior_after: Recovery dry-run rows are captured with a current-payload signature, cleared when Pending Publish evidence changes, and ignored by drain confidence/checklist/scope logic if unsigned or mismatched.
tests_added: Browser-backed Pending Publish drain guard regression for stale blocked recovery evidence clearing.
Static WebView contract coverage for pending recovery-plan freshness binding.
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView recovery signature binding and the related static/browser test assertions if the drain guard needs to return to unscoped recovery-plan behavior.
notes:

Ignore stale recovery dry-run rows in the backend drain-scope preview.
